requirements.text: 3+ years of experience developing production software, or equivalent practical experience.
Strong experience building backend services, APIs, and asynchronous applications using TypeScript and Node.js.
Hands-on experience developing cloud-native applications using AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway, EventBridge, SQS, and related serverless services.
Working knowledge of PHP and familiarity reading and understanding WordPress applications, plugins, REST APIs, and data models.
Understanding of database design, DynamoDB data modeling, and relational databases such as MySQL.
Experience writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code with strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
Ability to communicate effectively within a remote, collaborative engineering team and work successfully across technical and non-technical partners.

Preferred experience with Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK, Terraform, SAM, or Serverless Framework), CI/CD pipelines, event-driven architectures, observability tools, React, or AI-assisted development workflows.
